title: SAGA: Sparse 4D-anchor video compression accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Congratulations to G. Gao, S. Teng, C. Wang, F. Zhang, N. Anantrasirichai, J.-C. Chiang, W.-H. Peng, and D. Bull on having the paper “Gaussian Splatting-based Volumetric Video Compression with Sparse 4D Anchors” accepted for publication at NeurIPS 2026.

title: Two MAPL papers accepted to VCIP 2026
summary: Congratulations to Huu-Tai Phung, Chun-Hung Wu, Yen-Kuan Ho, Yu-Hsiang Lin, Tzu-Hsiang Chou, Leandro Weber Tavares, Guilherme Ribeiro Corrêa, and Wen-Hsiao Peng on having the paper “NICER: Neural Image Codecs with Randomness for Perceptual Quality Adaptation” accepted for publication at VCIP 2026. Congratulations to Cheng-Wei Yang, Ming-Zhe He, Yun-Yu Lee, Fan-Yi Hsu, He-Bi Yang, Jing-Zhong Chen, Shin-Tzu Chu, Fan Zhang, Nantheera Anantrasirichai, Jui-Chiu Chiang, and Wen-Hsiao Peng on having the paper “Perceptual 3D Gaussian Splatting with 3D-Anchored Saliency Features” accepted for publication at VCIP 2026.

title: MAPL is recruiting students
summary: MAPL is recruiting highly self-motivated students. The current laboratory introduction and interview information are available through the linked recruitment brief.

title: Prof. Peng joins MERL as Visiting Faculty
summary: Prof. Wen-Hsiao Peng is serving as Visiting Faculty at Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories in Massachusetts from August 2026 to January 2027.

title: Prof. Peng appointed at Leibniz University Hannover
summary: Prof. Wen-Hsiao Peng is serving as Part-time Professor in Generative Models for Artificial Intelligence at Leibniz University Hannover from June 2026 to June 2028.

title: Workshop on Emerging and Immersive Visual Media
summary: The APSIPA Taipei Local Chapter and H & J Global Chair Program hosted a workshop organized by Prof. Wen-Hsiao Peng on multimodal Gaussian splatting, video-coding hardware, post-training quantization, and neural 3D/4D media coding.

title: Four MAPL papers accepted to ICIP 2026
summary: The paper “ADAPT: Any-Codec Diffusion-Based Adaptation for Per-Image Perception-Distortion Trade-Off” was accepted for publication at ICIP 2026. The paper “IC-4DGS: Illumination-Compensated 4D Gaussian Splatting under Photometric Variations” was accepted for publication at ICIP 2026. The paper “Network Quantization in Neural Video Coding: A Comparative Study Across Coding Frameworks and Temporal Buffering Strategies” was accepted for publication at ICIP 2026. The paper “Rate-Distortion-Complexity Analysis of Parametric Video Codecs” was accepted for publication at ICIP 2026.

title: LiDAR-guided image compression paper accepted to TMM
summary: The paper “LiDAR-Guided Learned Image Compression for Machine Vision” was accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Multimedia in 2026.

title: Yi-Hsin Chen wins IEEE Taipei Best PhD Dissertation Award
summary: Yi-Hsin Chen received the 2025 Best PhD Dissertation Award from the IEEE Taipei Section for work on contextual image and video coding.

title: Four MAPL papers accepted to WACV 2026
summary: Four MAPL papers were accepted to WACV 2026: CSGaussian, milliMamba, TED-4DGS, and MEGA-PCC, covering joint 3D Gaussian compression and segmentation, radar pose estimation, 4D Gaussian compression, and joint geometry and attribute point cloud compression.

title: Yi-Hsin Chen receives TSC doctoral thesis Excellence Award
summary: Yi-Hsin Chen received the Excellence Award in the doctoral division of the 18th TSC Thesis Award for work on learning-based contextual video coding.

title: HyTIP and MH-LVC accepted to ICCV 2025
summary: Two MAPL papers on hybrid temporal information propagation and multi-hypothesis temporal prediction were accepted for publication at ICCV 2025.

title: APSIPA talk on Cosmos World Foundation Models
summary: APSIPA Taiwan and the H&J Global Chair hosted an invited talk by Dr. Ming-Yu Liu on world foundation models for physical AI.

image.alt: Participants at the APSIPA Cosmos World Foundation Models talk

title: Prof. Peng elevated to IEEE Fellow
summary: Prof. Wen-Hsiao Peng was elevated to IEEE Fellow, Class of 2025, for contributions to the design and implementation of video coding algorithms and standards.

title: TransHuPR accepted to BMVC 2024
summary: The paper “TransHuPR: Cross-View Fusion Transformer for Human Pose Estimation Using mmWave Radar” was accepted for publication at BMVC 2024.

title: Prof. Peng serves as PCS 2024 Technical Program Chair
summary: Prof. Wen-Hsiao Peng served as Technical Program Chair of the 2024 Picture Coding Symposium in Taichung, Taiwan.

title: Prof. Peng appointed JETCAS Editor-in-Chief
summary: Prof. Wen-Hsiao Peng was appointed Editor-in-Chief of the IEEE Journal on Emerging and Selected Topics in Circuits and Systems.
